scope: Sanitized architecture reasoning; no live connection or deployment.

cases.title: Assign responsibilities in three deployment diagrams
cases.input_contract: The three diagrams and the proposal stating cluster deploy mode.
cases.expected: A role/location table for all three layouts, with collect returning to the driver wherever it runs and resource allocation assigned to the cluster manager.
cases.verification: Name every role and trace a collected 30-row result to the actual driver process in each layout;identify the submitting-host-loss or remote-driver-environment failure.

cases.title: Repair a driver-only input path assumption
cases.input_contract: The input path in the sanitized proposal and evidence that the file exists only on the submitting machine.
cases.expected: An explicit data-location/distribution contract naming driver and executor visibility, authorization,30-row fixture identity and readback verification.
cases.verification: Reject automatic shared-path assumptions and list the exact host/process where existence and content must be checked.

cases.title: Map dependencies to driver and executor environments
cases.input_contract: Spark 4.0.1, Scala binary 2.13, JDK 17, course_2.13.jar, rules.zip and an unqualified native-extension wheel.
cases.expected: A matrix locating each dependency and its qualification evidence;reject aScala 3 binary substitution and treating a native wheel as an ordinary pure-Python source zip.
cases.verification: Name compiler/binary family, Python interpreter/platform compatibility and worker import checks separately.

cases.title: Review a captured connection and a retrying task
cases.input_contract: An open driver connection captured by a task function and evidence that a failed task can be retried.
cases.expected: No connection object serialized from the driver;a defined task-side resource lifecycle if externalIO is later authorized, and a stable operation identity preventing duplicate external effects.
cases.verification: Explain why serializability alone would not guarantee exactly-once writes and name the cleanup and deduplication evidence needed.

cases.title: Define the Connect adapter boundary honestly
cases.input_contract: The existing _jdf/queryExecution and RDD-based diagnostic helpers, plus the proposed remote logical-plan client.
cases.expected: Classic internals are not assumed available;semantic goldens are retained while a separate supported diagnostic/runtime adapter is qualified.
cases.verification: List client/server version checks, API support, cancellation, result limits, authentication and cleanup receipts without claiming any already ran.

cases.title: Write a reviewable deployment acceptance checklist
cases.input_contract: All previous design findings, the 30-row/schema/digest contract and only an existing local classic runtime receipt.
cases.expected: A bounded acceptance plan separating proposed configuration, artifact inspection, remote execution and production readiness;unresolved path/package/Connect gaps remain explicit.
cases.verification: Name concrete artifacts and receipts, owners and failure actions;do not mark deployment accepted based on diagram orsyntax alone.
